rowText: docs/roadmap.md: 'The panel can get into a state where pressing Down stops half way and the Ask button is out of reach' (star 3, [focus]). Recipe: a brand-new, empty chat started while the panel was showing a Session context row (turns carried from another chat); from the question box, Down, Right, Left, Down, Up. A hit is Down/Right/Left/Down all leaving the ring exactly where it was, with only Up escaping.

setup.chatUsed: a brand-new chat created from 44f2ff8b (black mesa / gonarch), with a Session context (1 turn) row showing -- this same setup also reproduced the ghost-reply bug (plan61-ghostreply-try1.json), so the new chat was not visually empty, but the row's own recipe only cares about the Session context row being present, which it was

steps.expected: reach a real control below it
either move sideways or correctly claim the press with no move (nothing to the side of Ask)
steps.landing: did not move (still on ask) -- expected, matches the documented clean shape

verdictSentence: This time Down from the question box actually reached the Ask button and could climb back out with Up -- the trap (Down going nowhere at all) did not show up. The entry stays open; this is one more clean run added to the count.
